review.explanation: Owned-constant cold overhead is 2.3775775ms at32 owners and2.3327325ms at128; added incremental retained heap is260712/262272 bytes. Unknown/trivial/ill-typed overheads remain recorded performance debt, not relabeled as speedups or dismissed as noise.

All warmups and worker-level observations remain in the raw report. In128-owner owned-constant, pooled warm median grows5.15%, whereas median of process medians grows16.64%; neither process nor aggregation is dropped.
